Title: Plugin Distribution Server Integration
Content:
## Solution Purpose
Plugin distribution server integration supporting multiple custom servers for end users.

## Scope
- Allow end users to add their own plugin servers
- Query packages from servers (filter by OS/arch)
- Download packages with content hash verification
- Get package icons
- Index packages from multiple servers
- Queue and manage downloads with progress tracking

## Core Responsibilities
- `IPluginServerService`: CRUD for servers, enable/disable, event notifications
- `IPluginPackageService`: Query packages, download packages, search across servers
- `IPackageManager`: Coordinates package indexing and download queue management
- `PluginServerOptions`: Default servers, HTTP timeout, retry settings

## API Endpoints (from Packages Consumer API Reference)
- `GET /api/applications/{appId}/packages` - List packages (os, arch filters)
- `GET /api/applications/{appId}/packages/{id}` - Get package details
- `GET /api/applications/{appId}/packages/{id}/download` - Download ZIP
- `GET /api/applications/{appId}/packages/{id}/icon` - Get icon

## Supported Filters
- OS: "win", "mac", "linux", "android"
- Arch: "x64", "arm64", "x86", "armv7"

## Architecture
- Contracts define interfaces (IPluginServerService, IPluginPackageService, IPackageManager)
- Services implement contracts (thread-safe server management)
- Models: PluginServer, Package, PackageVersion, PackageQueryOptions, IndexedPackage, DownloadQueueItem
- Options: PluginServerOptions for configuration
- Extensions: AddPluginServerServices for DI registration

## Events
- `IPluginServerService.ServersChanged`: Raised when servers are modified (triggers PackageManager re-indexing)
